<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer this without a structure is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically 120‑140 ppm). By counting those signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
